sources: Schkade & Kahneman (1998). Does living in California make people happy? A focusing illusion in judgments of life satisfaction. Psychological Science 9(5). 1,993 students (Michigan, Ohio State, UCLA, UC Irvine). Own life satisfaction equal across regions; both groups predicted Californians more satisfied; difference mediated by climate. Closing line: 'Nothing that you focus on will make as much difference as you think.'
